description: REMAX helps users find residential listings from REMAX Austria, Germany, and Switzerland in ChatGPT. Users can search by location, price, property type, rooms, size, amenities, and visual attributes; count matching listings; and retrieve a specific listing by remax.at, remax.de, or remax.ch URL. Results include public listing details, prices with currency, location, images when available, and broker contact information.
